title: Apply the dimension-2 transfer to X102's 16-edge state
body:
## Summary
- The dimension-1 transfer leaves X102 on 16 edges: 7 through departure slot 204 and 9 through departure slot 205. Dimension 2 grants X102 no new read.
- Slot 165, the second departure of channel 82, uses the same plane as slot 205, so the transfer adds slot 165's 9 edges. Slot 204's 7 edges stay on their own plane. The resulting count is 25.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The dimension-3 relation is not built.
